description: This file is a shell script designed to manage external toolchain tasks in a build environment, particularly for cross-compiling with OpenWrt. It includes functions for testing compiler capabilities, discovering libraries and binaries in a specified toolchain directory, wrapping compiler and linker binaries, and generating configuration snippets based on the detected environment.

methods.name: test_c
methods.description: Checks if the C compiler can compile a simple program.

methods.name: test_cxx
methods.description: Checks if the C++ compiler can compile a simple program.

methods.name: test_softfloat
methods.description: Tests support for soft floating point.

methods.name: test_uclibc
methods.description: Detects if the toolchain uses uClibc.

methods.name: print_config
methods.description: Generates and prints a .config file for the specified build target based on detected capabilities.

methods.name: find_libs
methods.description: Finds shared library files matching a given specification in the toolchain.

methods.name: find_bins
methods.description: Finds binary executables matching a given specification in the toolchain.

methods.name: find_gcc_version
methods.description: Detects the version of GCC used in the toolchain.

methods.name: probe_cc
methods.description: Locates the C compiler in the toolchain directory.

methods.name: probe_cxx
methods.description: Locates the C++ compiler in the toolchain directory.

methods.name: probe_cpp
methods.description: Locates the C preprocessor in the toolchain directory.

methods.name: probe_libc
methods.description: Detects the libc implementation used by the toolchain.

methods.name: wrap_bin_cc
methods.description: Creates a wrapper script for the C compiler.

methods.name: wrap_bin_ld
methods.description: Creates a wrapper script for the linker.

methods.name: wrap_bin_other
methods.description: Creates a wrapper script for other binaries.
